description: Ingests a single custom event into a Sentry project using its DSN via the Envelope ingestion endpoint. This may create or update an issue group depending on Sentry's grouping algorithm. Note: Sentry does not provide a direct API to 'create an issue group'; issues are created from ingested events. This tool allows controlled generation of events for testing or workflows requiring synthetic events.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for ingesting a custom event into Sentry via DSN.

dsn.description: The Sentry DSN (Data Source Name) string in format: {PROTOCOL}://{PUBLIC_KEY}@{HOST}{PATH}/{PROJECT_ID}. This is used to authenticate and route the event to the correct project.
dsn.title: Dsn

environment.description: Environment name where the event occurred.
environment.title: Environment

event_id.description: Optional event ID (32-character hex UUID without dashes). If not provided, one will be auto-generated.
event_id.title: Event Id

exception_type.description: The exception type/class name. Required if you want to send an exception instead of a message.
exception_type.title: Exception Type

exception_value.description: The exception message/value. Used in conjunction with exception_type.
examples: Invalid input: expected integer, got string
exception_value.title: Exception Value

extra.description: Arbitrary additional metadata to attach to the event. All values will be converted to strings.
extra.title: Extra

fingerprint.description: List of strings used to control event grouping/deduplication. By default, Sentry groups events by stack trace.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

logger.description: Logger name that created the event.
logger.title: Logger

message.description: The error message. Either 'message' or 'exception' must be provided. Use message for simple log-like events.
message.title: Message

release.description: Release version identifier for this event.
release.title: Release

tags.description: Key-value pairs for tagging the event. Each tag value must be a string and less than 200 characters.
tags.title: Tags

user_ip_address.description: User IP address for user context.
user_ip_address.title: User Ip Address

inputSchema.title: IngestEventViaDsnRequest

name: ingest_event_via_dsn

IngestEventViaDsnResponse.description: Response schema for event ingestion via DSN.

event_id.description: The event ID that was submitted to Sentry. Use this to reference the event.
event_id.title: Event Id

http_status.description: HTTP status code returned by Sentry (200 indicates successful ingestion).
http_status.title: Http Status

rate_limit_info.description: Rate limit information from X-Sentry-Rate-Limits header, if present. Format: 'retry_after:categories:scope:reason_code'.
rate_limit_info.title: Rate Limit Info

retry_after.description: Value from Retry-After header if rate limited (429 response).
retry_after.title: Retry After

IngestEventViaDsnResponse.title: IngestEventViaDsnResponse
